conversion.altitudeCrossCheck: All six 10,000-ft grid steps map exactly to the printed SI altitude grid using 0.3048 m/ft.
conversion.rationale: The report states measurements/calculations were made in U.S. Customary Units. Multiplying every printed U.S. customary thrust cell by 4.448 and rounding to the nearest integer reproduces all 90 printed SI thrust cells. The exact modern lbf definition is not used to overwrite the source's published SI integers.
